english.note: Use this when stressing that something was unexpected or that the outcome was not what you anticipated.
This is the all-purpose choice for an unexpected result, event, or development.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for an accidental event or result that is unexpected, especially when no intention is specified.
Use this when the amazement mainly comes from something being unexpected.
Use this when describing an unexpected or surprising result, event, or situation, especially predicatively.
Use this when the astonishment mainly comes from something being unexpected or unforeseen.
Use this for the less forceful sense of being unexpected or surprising.
